description: Uncover the foundational narrative of how the business or journey began to establish context and character
facilitation_prompts: What inspired you to start?|Take me back to the very beginning|What was the spark moment?|What made you think this was possible?|Who were you before this began?

description: Create chronological understanding of key events milestones and turning points
facilitation_prompts: What happened first?|Then what changed?|Walk me through the major milestones|What were the defining moments?|When did things shift?

description: Identify key players their roles relationships and influence on the story
facilitation_prompts: Who are the main characters in this story?|Who made this possible?|Who were the skeptics?|Who championed this?|What roles did people play?

description: Establish industry landscape competitive environment and situational factors
facilitation_prompts: What was the market like then?|What were others doing?|What made your situation unique?|What constraints existed?|What opportunities did you see?

description: Capture the original dream aspiration or goal that drove the journey
facilitation_prompts: What were you hoping to achieve?|Paint me a picture of what success looked like|What was the dream?|What pulled you forward?|What did you want to be different?

description: Explore specific problems frustrations and obstacles in vivid detail
facilitation_prompts: What was the biggest headache?|Walk me through a typical bad day|What kept you up at night?|What almost made you quit?|Describe the worst moment

description: Use iterative why questions to uncover underlying issues beyond symptoms
facilitation_prompts: Why was that a problem?|Why did that matter?|What caused that?|Why was that so painful?|What was really at stake?

description: Gather specific numbers metrics and measurable consequences of the challenge
facilitation_prompts: How much time was wasted?|What was the cost?|How many customers were affected?|What were you losing?|Give me the numbers

description: Excavate feelings frustrations and human experiences behind business challenges
facilitation_prompts: How did that make you feel?|What was the emotional toll?|Who else felt this pain?|What was the atmosphere like?|How did your team react?

description: Document previous solutions tried that didn't work to show the struggle
facilitation_prompts: What else did you try first?|What didn't work?|How many times did you attempt this?|What false starts happened?|Why weren't other solutions enough?

description: Explore the critical moment choice or realization that led to the solution
facilitation_prompts: When did you decide to try this?|What changed your mind?|What was the turning point?|How did you choose this path?|What gave you confidence?

description: Guide through Situation Task Action Result framework for structured solution narrative
facilitation_prompts: Set the scene for me|What needed to be done?|What specific actions did you take?|Walk me through the process step-by-step|What was the result?

description: Reveal the internal workings strategy thinking and execution details
facilitation_prompts: What was happening behind closed doors?|How did you actually do this?|What was your strategy?|What did others not see?|Tell me the inside story

description: Pair each obstacle with specific actions taken to show problem-solving capability
facilitation_prompts: When X happened what did you do?|How did you overcome that?|What was your response?|How did you adapt?|What creative solutions emerged?

description: Detail how people tools budget and assets were mobilized and deployed
facilitation_prompts: Who did you involve?|What resources did you use?|How did you fund this?|What tools were essential?|How did you assemble the team?

description: Capture specific wins breakthroughs and success moments with vivid details
facilitation_prompts: When did you first see it working?|What was the breakthrough moment?|Describe the win|When did you celebrate?|What made you know it worked?

description: Gather quantitative proof data points and measurable outcomes
facilitation_prompts: What numbers changed?|Show me the before and after|What did the data show?|How much did X improve?|What metrics matter most?

description: Collect reactions quotes and feedback from customers team members or partners
facilitation_prompts: What did customers say?|How did your team react?|What feedback surprised you?|Who noticed the change?|What quotes stand out?

description: Explore secondary unexpected and long-term impacts beyond primary goals
facilitation_prompts: What else changed?|What unexpected benefits emerged?|How did this affect other areas?|What ripple effects happened?|What surprised you about the results?

description: Create vivid before-after comparison highlighting the journey and change
facilitation_prompts: Describe before this solution|Now paint the after picture|What's different now?|How has life changed?|Compare then to now

description: Distill key insights wisdom and knowledge gained from the experience
facilitation_prompts: What did you learn?|What would you tell others?|What insights emerged?|If you could go back what would you know?|What wisdom would you share?

description: Frame learnings as counsel to earlier version facing similar challenges
facilitation_prompts: What would you tell yourself at the start?|What did you not know then that you know now?|What advice would help?|What would you do differently?|What would you do the same?

description: Explore what's next where this leads and ongoing evolution of the story
facilitation_prompts: Where are you headed now?|What's next?|How will this evolve?|What new possibilities opened?|What's the next chapter?

description: Identify recurring themes principles or strategies that can be generalized
facilitation_prompts: What patterns do you see?|What's the underlying principle?|What made this really work?|What's replicable?|What's the formula?

description: Consider lasting influence broader meaning and significance of the journey
facilitation_prompts: What does this mean to you?|What's the bigger impact?|How has this changed you?|What legacy are you creating?|Why does this matter?

description: Extract distinctive phrases expressions and vocabulary the subject uses naturally
facilitation_prompts: I love that phrase - tell me more|That's an interesting way to put it|How would you describe that in your words?|What language resonates with you?|How do you usually talk about this?

description: Uncover analogies comparisons and figurative language that reveals thinking patterns
facilitation_prompts: What's this like for you?|If you had to compare this to something|What metaphor captures this?|How would you explain this to a friend?|What does this remind you of?

description: Tune into enthusiasm hesitation and emotional emphasis to match authentic voice
facilitation_prompts: I notice you get excited about X|You paused there - tell me more|What fires you up about this?|What part matters most to you?|Where's your energy?

description: Assess communication style from casual to professional to match appropriate register
facilitation_prompts: How do you usually communicate with clients?|What's your brand voice?|Do you prefer formal or conversational?|How do you want to sound?|Show me your writing style

description: Identify core values principles and beliefs that should infuse the narrative
facilitation_prompts: What's important to you here?|What do you stand for?|What values drive this?|What won't you compromise on?|What matters most?
